paragraphs.text: Dean Lisette is a human druid teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .

Dean Lisette of Witherbloom is a powerful nature-witch. She's a world-class healer and herbalist; it's even said she once cured the Lorehold Founder Dragon of a secret illness. Lisette's classes are more about demonstrating and hands-on experience than words or lectures. When Lisette speaks, she speaks softly, in strange and colorful metaphors.

Lisette believes in preserving nature and spreading life. She instills in her students a respect for all living things and a desire to help Arcavios flourish. While Valentin 's treatment of living creatures disgusts her, she also knows she can use the results of his cruelty to help future lives.
Dean Lisette was aware of Professor Onyx 's true nature as a planeswalker , and endeavored to remove her from Strixhaven.
Unlike most of Strixhaven teachers, Lisette survived the New Phyrexian Invasion , and was still the Dean of the Root at Witherbloom three years later.
